drugs.name: CYTARabine
drugs.notes: Harrison's 22nd ed. lines 117633/117784: 'cytarabine used at standard dose (100-200 mg/m2)... administered as a continuous intravenous infusion for 7 days.' Source prints a range (100-200 mg/m2/d); 100 mg/m2/d used here as the standard/most-referenced value, 200 mg/m2/d is the upper end of the printed range - confirm institutional standard.

drugs.name: DAUNOrubicin
drugs.notes: Harrison's 22nd ed. lines 117636/117649/117650/117784: 'daunorubicin (60-90 mg/m2)... on days 1, 2, and 3 (the 7+3 regimen)'; older/fit patients get 'idarubicin (12 mg/m2) or daunorubicin (60 mg/m2)'. Source prints a range (60-90 mg/m2/d); 60 mg/m2/d used here as the standard/most-referenced value. Line 117650: high-dose daunorubicin (90 mg/m2) not recommended for patients >65 yr. Cumulative-lifetime cap values (450/550 mg/m2) are the conventional doxorubicin-equivalent anthracycline safety thresholds, not printed in this source for daunorubicin specifically - verify institutional doxorubicin-equivalent conversion before enforcing.

drugs.name: IDArubicin
drugs.notes: Harrison's 22nd ed. lines 117636/117784: 'idarubicin (12 mg/m2)... on days 1, 2, and 3 (the 7+3 regimen)'. Alternative (either/or) substitute for daunorubicin per source, not additive - only one of daunorubicin or idarubicin is given per cycle. Cumulative-lifetime cap values (450/550 mg/m2) are the conventional doxorubicin-equivalent anthracycline safety thresholds, not printed in this source for idarubicin specifically - verify institutional doxorubicin-equivalent conversion before enforcing.
